title: Eric Walker on TRW board

tellings.quote: interesting fact about TRW Jacques Valet has talked about Dr. Eric A. Walker we talked about earlier being a on the board of directors or a chairman of TRW as well.

plain: Eric A. Walker, a scientist who came up earlier in the conversation, is said to have sat on the board of directors of TRW, a major American aerospace and defense company, and maybe even to have chaired it. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this, citing the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, who has talked about it. The point is that it ties Walker to a large defense contractor.
